mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "orders" ( order_no, member_id, status, payment_method, shipping_method, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, subtotal_amount, shipping_fee, discount_amount, bonus_used, total_amount, remark ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{memberId}, #{status}, #{paymentMethod}, #{shippingMethod}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{subtotalAmount}, #{shippingFee}, #{discountAmount}, #{bonusUsed}, #{totalAmount}, #{remark} )
mapper.select: SELECT order_item_id as orderItemId, order_id as orderId, product_id as productId, product_code as productCode, product_name as productName, product_image as productImage, size_name as sizeName, unit_price as unitPrice, quantity, subtotal, created_at as createdAt FROM "order_item" WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT * FROM "orders" WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "orders"
(order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR receiver_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND status = #{status}
AND created_at >= CAST(#{startDate} AS TIMESTAMP)
AND created_at < CAST(#{endDate} AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 day'
mapper.update: UPDATE "orders" SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
